lines.en: I move with shells all over me
My shells knock against each other
Wet and dripping, I haul onto the sand.
My steps trail dampness
I walk slowly along the sand
A shell shifts on my back
I shift along heavily

lines.zh: 我的影子碎成一片一片
lines.en: My shadow breaks into pieces
I straighten up out of the shallows
I crush a shell underfoot
I move slower than the tide
I round a heap of wet stones
I stand there and the shells sound
The sea is all over me
I listen to the sound inside the shells
My fingers curl slowly
Those shells are not ones I gathered
Wet weed hangs off me
I sway in place
My breath carries damp

lines.zh: 我低头看自己身上的壳
lines.en: I look down at the shells on me
These shells move by themselves
I listen toward the water
My motion stops for a moment
I rest a hand on a heap of shells

lines.zh: 有水流从壳缝里渗出来
lines.en: Water seeps from between the shells
I raise my face from the shells
Do you hear the shells
My eyes watch from the gaps

lines.zh: 你站的地方有我掉的壳
lines.en: You stand where I shed a shell
One shell drops off me
You had better not touch those shells
My shoulder has not stopped moving

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几处软的地方
lines.en: I am counting the soft places on you
My voice sounds like shells grinding
Step back and the shells quiet
I tilt my head aside

lines.zh: 我的壳把你的影子分开了
lines.en: My shells split your shadow

lines.zh: 你看，这里的壳比别处多
lines.en: See, there are more shells here

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，沙子落下来
lines.en: I lift a hand and sand falls

lines.zh: 你的动作让壳全都响了
lines.en: Your motion sets every shell ringing
I lean slowly your way
The wet on me catches the light
You stand among broken shells
I count how many steps you take back
A piece of me shatters
Several shells shake loose
That loosened every shell
I bend to shield the shells
Shards ring at my feet
I can still stand in the surf
I still have plenty on me
Do not touch those shells again
You drop it on the sand
The shells shift that way
This is not what I eat
That is far too dry
I need something wet
It lands by my feet
I do not reach for it
The shells on me stay still
I must wait on the tide
You hit my shells
A shell cracks on the ground
You skid back half a step
A whole chord rings off me
You slip off me
Broken shells litter the ground
That one only made noise
The shells on me close again
Your hands come away full of shards

lines.zh: 我把掉下来的壳收回去
lines.en: I gather the fallen shells back
There are others in the water
We know each other by the sound of shells
Her shells are whiter
We walked a stretch side by side
We do not speak of such things
The rising tide scatters us
I look down at my own shells
And I go back into the water
We stay close without touching

lines.zh: 她的声音在沙上传得远
lines.en: Her sound carries over the sand
I pick up a shell
This one is not mine
I press it onto myself
It sticks at once
One more on me
There is still a little water in it
I set it back on the sand
I lay this one on top
It is thinner than the rest
You stepped on the shells
All my shells ring at once
It made me unsteady
You stepped onto my shore
I have shifted your way
Every shell on me turns to you
You smell dry
I do not mean to give way
The shells are creeping your way
I raise a sandy hand
The ground under you is not firm
The water has started to sound
I have picked my line
This whole shore is mine

lines.zh: 碎壳在我脚下咯吱作响
lines.en: Broken shells crunch beneath my feet
It is already too late to back off
You go left, the shells go left
I follow along the waterline
My steps make a cluttered sound
The sand under you is sliding
My shells block half the path
I wait for you to turn away
Water is over your shoes
One more shift and I am there
Broken shells cover your way back
Every shell on me is sounding
I have not sped up at all
I keep to the waterline
My cluttered footsteps
Do you hear these shells sounding
You are only steps from me
The sand is sliding under you
Every shell on me points at you
I can catch you without running
I clamp a hand on your arm
A shard opens your hand
I hit you, shells and all
The shells on me rake you
You are hauled forward
I press you into the sand
I twist my body
Shards fall into your clothes
You pull back, and I still ring
I catch your belt

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整只手臂
lines.en: That came with my whole arm
You are shoved down onto the sand
I haul you into the surf
A shell breaks in my grip
I reach for you again
Your feet slip out from under you
A layer of shells surfaces first
Broken shells litter the sand
The shells on me clatter

lines.zh: 水从我的指缝里漏下去
lines.en: Water leaks between my fingers
I leave wet prints up the shore
My head breaks the surf
The weed at the bank stirs
I climb up from the bottom
Wet sand clings to me
A run of shells rings out as I steady
The water at my feet turns cloudy
The far water ripples too
I open my hands slowly
All the shells face one way
I lift my shoulders
The waterline moves up the shore
My shadow falls on the wet sand
The shells move before I do
I lift my head and water runs off
The heat bleaches my shells
Shards scatter when I land
Too deep, and I go under

lines.zh: 冲击把我身上的壳打散
lines.en: The blast strips the shells off me
An arrow sticks in a shell
Magic sets the shells ringing
There is less and less to eat by the water
Lightning runs through my wet shells
Shards trail off me as I fall
